decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is the strategic flagship and rests directly on the firm's curing, seasoning and organic know-how, so management can interpret its results and keep refining the line.

The premium sharing salami line draws on core maturation and recipe capabilities, so the firm can adapt its variants from market feedback rather than withdraw it, although snack formats proved fragile with Product B.
The organic Fleischwurst extends a traditional boiled-sausage competence into the growing organic range, so early results are easy to read and act on.

The organic thin-sliced chicken breast is a step into poultry, where the withdrawn Product B shows the firm's knowledge is thinner, but it fits the organic direction and the line deserves more time to learn from.
The organic herb-coated salami relies on in-house seasoning and salami maturation expertise, so the firm can absorb feedback and adjust the recipe within its existing competencies.
